text:
Samir Patel: Hey all — we need to schedule the PIR for last night's production incident (storage kv-cache spike). Looking for a facilitator (preferably not someone on the on-call chain that day). 30-45m.

Samir Patel: Tentative windows I think will work across teams:
```
Tue 10:00am PDT (18:00 UTC)
Wed 4:00pm CET (15:00 UTC)
Thu 2:00pm PDT (22:00 UTC)
```
Please call out availability or propose other slots. Also ping folks who must be in: runtime, eng-sre, product, CS eng.

incident-bot: Incident #2041 — Kv-cache eviction storm — Pager triggered 02:17 UTC, mitigation: scaled read-proxy + rollback quantized model, customer impact: 13 tenants experienced elevated latencies for ~18m, severity: Sev2. Link: https://rwinf.incidents/2041

oncall Rotation Bot: Next oncall for SRE: @Maya Torres (2026-06-02 to 2026-06-09). Reminder link: https://rwinf.ops/oncall

Jules Nguyen: I can do Tue 10 PDT. Happy to facilitate if Maya is oncall? Otherwise I prefer to avoid being the one to write the doc — can co-facilitate. :hand:

Priya Rao: Tue morning looks ok for me (Pacific). Can attend.

Maya Torres: I am oncall that week so can't facilitate — will attend for handoff notes. FYI I have the raw timeline logs already.

Tom Becker: Thu 2pm PDT works best for me (travel Wed). If someone else wants to run Tue, +1 for Tue.

Elena Park: I can do Wed 4pm CET (that's fine for EU folks). If we aim for Tue, I might be tight on prep time but can make it.

Samir Patel: Cool. Looks like Tue 10 PDT has the most early thumbs. Need someone to volunteer to facilitate and run the write-up. Options: Jules (volunteer), Maya can't, Tom out. Jules — are you okay facilitating AND owning the initial draft? If not, we can split: facilitator runs the meeting, another owner drafts the postmortem doc.

Jules Nguyen: I can facilitate and take the draft. I'll need a scribe to capture action items + timelines. Who can scribe? Preferably someone not oncall.

Priya Rao: I can scribe for the meeting. Will capture decisions and action owners.

Samir Patel: Great — facilitator: Jules, scribe: Priya. I'll create the calendar invite and add the standard PIR agenda.

Samir Patel: Agenda (short):
- 5m: quick exec summary + timeline
- 10m: what went wrong technically (root causes and contributing factors)
- 10m: mitigations + why they worked/didn't
- 10m: action items, owners, and timelines
- 5m: follow-ups and rollout verification plan

Jules Nguyen: Will prep a 2-slide summary (timeline + initial RCA points). Priya — can you pluck key logs from the oncall timeline and paste them into the doc beforehand? That will speed things up.

Priya Rao: Yep — I'll drop the timeline snippets into the doc by EOD today.

Samir Patel: Adding the people we should invite: @runtime-team (Elena, Tom), @eng-sre (Maya), @product (Ava K.), @cs-eng (Rafael). Elena/Tom can you confirm if product or CS should bring additional folks?

Elena Park: Product (Ava) should join for customer impact + messaging. CS (Rafael) if any big customers need post-incident outreach. I'll ping them.

Tom Becker: Rafael is out this week — if CS needs to be present, recommend Rafael's backup (Lina). I'll ping Lina.

Samir Patel: I'll create the doc and calendar invite  — link placeholder: https://rwinf.docs/pir-2041. Invite will include the pre-read section (logs + metrics) — please add anything you want pre-populated.

incident-bot: Reminder: PIR must be scheduled within 72 hours per SLO policy. Deadline: 1765068034 (72h).

Jules Nguyen: Noted. I'll add a short 'pre-reads' section and put my slides there.

Priya Rao: Quick note on attendee list: can we keep the headcount under 12? Makes the session actionable. I'll limit invites to core owners + observers as needed.

Samir Patel: Agreed. Core attendees: Jules (facilitator), Priya (scribe), Maya (oncall), Elena (runtime), Tom (runtime), Ava K. (product), Lina (cs backup), Samir (ops). Optional: Rafael, 1 engineering manager, 1 infra SME.

Jules Nguyen: I'll add an explicit section in the doc for 'action items' where we capture owner + due date + verification step. Example format:
```
- Owner: Priya Rao
  Action: Extract problematic keyspace patterns + add KV cache alert thresholds
  Due: 2026-06-10
  Verify: Load test + alert firing in staging
```

Maya Torres: FYI, I noted one immediate follow-up: tighten the KV-cache eviction backoff and add a circuit breaker metric. I'll file a ticket after the PIR if owners agree.

Samir Patel: Thanks — that's a good remediation candidate. We'll discuss prioritization in the meeting.

Elena Park: One logistic Q: can we record the session? For async folks. I'll add recording to the invite if no objections.

Tom Becker: Recording OK with me.

Priya Rao: Recording OK. I'll call out in the doc which parts are sensitive.

Samir Patel: Calendar invite set: Tue 10:00 PDT / 17:00 UTC (1765012000). Link: https://meet.rwinf/pir-2041. Pre-read doc linked. Please RSVP.

Jules Nguyen: RSVP: yes. I'll upload slides by tomorrow morning.

Priya Rao: RSVP: yes. I'll post timeline snippets by EOD.

Maya Torres: RSVP: yes (will forward timeline logs).

Elena Park: RSVP: tentative — waiting on product confirmation.

Tom Becker: RSVP: yes.

Samir Patel: Action items before meeting:
- Priya: timeline snippets in doc (due EOD today)
- Jules: slides + facilitator checklist (due morning of meeting)
- Samir: calendar + invite + pre-reads (done)
- Maya: oncall notes and suggested mitigations (attach to doc)

Elena Park: I'll confirm product attendance and add Ava if she can make it.

incident-bot: Incident #2041 status changed to: PIR Scheduled (owner: Jules Nguyen).

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone — if anything changes, update the doc or ping me directly. See you Tue.

Elena Park: Thanks — will confirm product and post if any blockers.
